question: uniqueness
claim: Unique for almost every attaining sample on any fixed-count chart with at least one nonzero freely varying residual, and pointwise on the all-center stratum. The sample (-d_*, 0 repeated 19998 times, d_*) at mu=0 and sigma=1 has exactly two winning positive widths, with d_* defined by the crossing in the proof. The normal is the unique maximizer iff the second moment about the held center does not exceed the held variance.
frontier: Resolve remaining pointwise equality of two stationary heights, including the normal seam.
